name: onboarder-nextjs
description: Platform-managed Next.js sandbox used by the onboarder's first-sandbox flow. Not a general-purpose template.
longDescription: A Blaxel-native Next.js sandbox built specifically for the onboarder's first-sandbox experience. It starts a live app on port 3000 and includes a Sandbox Lab page that proves the runtime has real processes, filesystem access, networked preview, and agent-ready workflows. Built on Alpine Linux with Node.js 24, sandbox-api, git, curl, and npm pre-installed.
